s: And sow the fields, and «plant» vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
As the waters fail from the sea, and the «flood» decayeth and drieth up:
And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the «river» reigned in his stead.
There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at «rest».
I have done judgment and justice: «leave» me not to mine oppressors.
But now the LORD my God hath «given» me «rest» on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

H5175.d: serpent, snake; serpent; image (of serpent); fleeing serpent (mythological)
s: And the woman said unto the «serpent», We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
At the last it biteth «like» a «serpent», and stingeth like an adder.

H5128.d: to quiver, totter, shake, reel, stagger, wander, move, sift, make move, wave, waver, tremble; (Niphal) to be tossed about or around
s: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be «shaken», they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
Let them «wander» up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

H5110.d: to shake, waver, wander, move to and fro, flutter, show grief, have compassion on
s: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall «bemoan» thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a «fugitive» and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of «Nod», on the east of Eden.

H5178.d: copper, bronze; copper (ore), bronze (as copper alloy); fetters (of copper or bronze); copper (as value)
s: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and «brass»,

H5146.d: A man living at the time before the Flood, first mentioned at Gen.5.29
s: And «Noah» was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

H5162.d: to be sorry, console oneself, repent, regret, comfort, be comforted; (Piel) to comfort, console; (Pual) to be comforted, be consoled
s: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to «comfort» him.
And the LORD «repented» of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

H5152.d: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.11.26;; son of Serug, father of Terah, and grandfather of Abraham; son of Terah and brother of Abraham
s: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, «Nahor», and Haran.
And Serug lived thirty years, and begat «Nahor»:

H5186.d: to stretch out, extend, spread out, pitch, turn, pervert, incline, bend, bow; (Niphal) to be stretched out
s: With a strong hand, and with a «stretched» «out» arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
I will «incline» mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
Your iniquities have «turned» away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.

H5127.d: to flee, escape; (Polel) to drive at; (Hithpolel) to take flight
s: But these five kings «fled», and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him «flee» before him.

H5141.d: ring, nose ring, earring; nose ring (woman's ornament); earring (ornament of men or women)
s: As an «earring» of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

H5148.d: to lead, guide; (Qal) to lead, bring; (Hiphil) to lead, guide
s: So the LORD alone did «lead» him, and there was no strange god with him.
In the daytime also he «led» them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
Thou shalt «guide» me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

H5138.d: boiled food, soup, pottage, thing sodden or boiled
s: And Jacob sod «pottage»: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

H5158.d: torrent, valley, wadi, torrent-valley; torrent; torrent-valley, wadi (as stream bed); shaft (of mine)
s: And he took them, and sent them over the «brook», and sent over that he had.
And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the «bank» of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

H5172.d: to practice divination, divine, observe signs, learn by experience, diligently observe, practice fortunetelling, take as an omen
s: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have «learned» by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

H5159.d: possession, property, inheritance, heritage; property; portion, share; inheritance, portion
s: Unto these the land shall be divided for an «inheritance» according to the number of names.
Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm «thine» «inheritance», when it was weary.
«Mine» heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.

H5184.d: A man of the Edomites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.13;; one of the dukes of Edom, son of Reuel and grandson of Esau; a Kohathite Levite, son of Zophai and grandson of Elkanah; an Levite overseer in the time of Hezekiah
s: The sons of Reuel; «Nahath», Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and «Nahath» his son,

And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and «Nahath», and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

H5139.d: consecrated or devoted one, Nazarite; consecrated one; devotee, Nazarite; untrimmed (vine)
s: And this is the law of the «Nazarite», when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy «vine» undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

H5177.d: A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Exo.6.23
s: Of Judah; «Nahshon» the son of Amminadab.

Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at «home», who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:

H5140.d: to flow, distil, flow forth or down, trickle, drop; (Hiphil) to cause to flow
s: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters «flow».

H5116.d: abode, habitation, abode of shepherds or flocks, pasture; abode (of sheep); abode (of shepherds); meadow; habitation
s: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his «habitation».

H5130.d: to move to and fro, wave; (Qal) to move; (Polel) to wave, brandish (in threat); (Hiphil) to swing, wield, wave; (Hophal) to be waved
s: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron «waved» for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.

H5157.d: to get as a possession, acquire, inherit, possess; (Piel) to divide for a possession; (Hithpael) to possess oneself of; (Hophal) to be allotted, be made to possess
s: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt «inherit» all nations.
Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God «giveth» thee to «inherit», into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.

H5145.d: consecration, crown, separation, Nazariteship; crown (as sign of consecration), earring; woman's hair; consecration
s: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy «crown» upon the mitre.
Cut off «thine» «hair», O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

H5137.d: to spurt, spatter, sprinkle; (Qal) to spurt, spatter; (Hiphil) to cause to spurt, sprinkle upon
s: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is «sprinkled» of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.

H5198.d: gum, drops of stacte; an aromatic gum resin of a shrub used in incense
s: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, «stacte», and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
For he maketh small the «drops» of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

H5126.d: A man of the tribe of Ephraim living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.33.11
s: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of «Nun».
Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and «feathers» unto the ostrich?

H5144.d: to dedicate, consecrate, separate; (Niphal) to dedicate oneself, devote oneself; (Hiphil) to keep sacredly separate
s: Thus shall ye «separate» the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
He shall «separate» himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

H5154.d: copper, bronze; copper (made from melting copper ore); bronze (made from copper and alloy)
s: Iron is taken out of the earth, and «brass» is molten out of the stone.

H5147.d: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.14
s: Of the tribe of Naphtali, «Nahbi» the son of Vophsi.
And from Mattanah to «Nahaliel»: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
Surely there is no «enchantment» against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

H5106.d: to hinder, hold back, forbid, disallow, restrain, frustrate; (Qal) to hinder, hold back
s: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and «disallowed» her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

H5197.d: to drop, drip, distil, prophesy, preach, discourse; (Qal) to drop, drip
s: For the lips of a strange woman «drop» as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
«Prophesy» ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.

H5181.d: to go down, descend; (Niphal) to come down into, penetrate; (Piel) to cause to descend, press down, stretch (a bow); (Hiphil) to bring down
s: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go «down» to the grave.

H5176.d: A man of the Ammonites living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.11.1; a king of the Ammonites during the time of king Saul; the father of Abigail, the mother of Amasa, the commander of Absalom's army
s: Then «Nahash» the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
Now it came to pass after this, that «Nahash» the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man’s son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of «Nahash», sister to Zeruiah Joab’s mother.

And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of «Nahash» of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-«nahash». These are the men of Rechah.
And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at «Naioth» in Ramah.

H5171.d: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.37
s: Zelek the Ammonite, «Naharai» the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

H5190.d: to lift, bear, bear up; (Qal) to lift, lift over, lift upon, set up; (Piel) to bear up

s: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it «Nehushtan».

H5179.d: A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.24.8
s: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name was «Nehushta», the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

H5163.d: A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.19
s: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of «Naham», the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
These were the potters, and those that dwelt among «plants» and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

H5114.d: A man of the Arabs living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.15
s: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and «Nodab».

H5119.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21
s: «Nohah» the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy «resting» «place», thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

H5166.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.1.1;; the son of Hachaliah, cupbearer to king Artaxerxes, who became governor of Judah after the return from exile; one of the 12 heads of the people who returned from exile with Zerubbabel …
s: Now those that sealed were, «Nehemiah», the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,
Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, «Nehemiah», Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

After him repaired «Nehemiah» the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
The men of «Netophah», fifty and six.
This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the «river», and at such a time.

H5142.d: to suffer injury; (P'al) to suffer injury; (Aphel) to injure

H5182.d: to descend; (P'al) to descend; (Aphel) to deposit; (Hophal) to be deposed, be cast down
s: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, «carry» them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.

H5129.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.8.33;; a Levite, son of Binnui, who weighed the vessels of gold and silver belonging to the temple which were brought back from Babylon; a prophetess who joined Sanballat and Tobiah in their attempt to intimidate Nehemiah
s: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and «Noadiah» the son of Binnui, Levites;
My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess «Noadiah», and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

H5167.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.7.7
s: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, «Nahamani», Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;

H5149.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2; also called Harim at Neh.10.5; 12.15;  Nehum at Neh.7.7
s: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, «Nehum», Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;

H5109.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.19

s: Doth the wild ass «bray» when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
This is my «comfort» in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of «brass»?

H5194.d: plantation, plant, planting; plantation; planting (act of); plant
s: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a «plant».

H5183.d: rest, quietness; quietness, quiet attitude; rest (of death)
s: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no «rest».
Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his «nostrils» is terrible.

The «snorting» of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
Out of his «nostrils» goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.

H5155.d: meaning uncertain; may be name of melody; may be a musical instrument; found only in title of Ps 5:1

H5102.d: to flow, stream; (Qal) to flow, stream
s: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed «up»: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
And in that day they shall roar against them «like» the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
Beautiful for «situation», the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
Thou tellest my «wanderings»: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

H5107.d: to bear fruit; (Qal) to bear fruit; (Pilel) to make to flourish (fig.)
s: They shall still bring forth «fruit» in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

H5125.d: (Niphal) continue, to increase, propagate; (Hiphil) continue, to increase, propagate

H5123.d: to be drowsy, slumber, sleep; (Qal) to slumber, be drowsy
s: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not «slumber».
That our sons may be as «plants» grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and «drowsiness» shall clothe a man with rags.
A stone is heavy, and the sand «weighty»; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.
I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see «whether» the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.
They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they «fled» away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.

H5189.d: twig, tendril, tendrils of a vine (as spread out)

s: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore «comforts» unto him and to his mourners.
I create the «fruit» of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.

H5161.d: Someone descended from Nehel(?), first mentioned at Jer.29.24
s: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the «Nehelamite», saying,
They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of «brass», of iron, of wood, and of stone.
And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning «fiery» furnace.
He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the «fire», and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

H5191.d: to lift; (P'al) to lift, lift up; (P'il) to be lifted
s: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was «lifted» up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.
I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: «repentance» shall be hid from mine eyes.

H5151.d: A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Nam.1.1
s: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of «Nahum» the Elkoshite.
Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that «bear» silver are cut off.
